column1: # source uses \n for a newline. compiles is typst compile.
# detect is the score snapper should give. A balanced #set before
# an unclosed group still scores; lines inside the group do not.
# Delimiters and # count outside strings and comments. An unclosed
# string or raw span owns the following lines. An unclosed block
# comment does too; a finished expression before it still scores.
#let x = true and false or true
# A ) closes (, a ] closes [, and a } closes {. A mismatched
# closer in code ends that statement, so a later statement can
# still score. A ) or } inside content is markup, and the code
# bracket stays open. A bare # expression owns later lines only
# while a group it opened is still open.
